QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_6

answer.text: Losses in situations that lie outside the coverage of VaR-based initial margins
The same scenarios as initial margin

explanation.text: The Logic: ELM is designed to cover losses in scenarios that lie outside the coverage of VaR-based initial margins. It is levied at 1 percent on gross open positions, providing an additional buffer for tail-risk events. The Trap: ELM is not the same as initial margin; it sits on top of it. It is not a delivery-default charge and it is not an administrative levy. Note: Distributor/cross-exam coaching labels removed; explanation rewritten with neutral wording.
